cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Content Writer position at your company. With over three years of experience in digital marketing and content creation, I have honed the skills necessary to produce compelling, SEO-friendly content that resonates with audiences and drives results.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I am responsible for writing keyword-targeted blog posts and on-page SEO for client websites. This involves researching industry-related topics, crafting clear marketing copy, and ensuring all content aligns with brand guidelines. I have successfully improved organic traffic for clients by implementing SEO best practices and collaborating with design teams to create visually engaging articles.

My technical background in web development and content management systems, including WordPress, Elementor, and Astra, allows me to prepare well-structured drafts and manage content efficiently. I am proficient in using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to conduct keyword research and track performance, ensuring that my content not only engages readers but also meets SEO objectives.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed my own project, mirook.com, where I have applied advanced SEO and GEO techniques, including structured data and entity optimization, to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has sharpened my ability to write content that is not only informative but also optimized for discoverability.

I am a deadline-driven writer with excellent English skills, and I am comfortable working with offshore clients. I am eager to bring my unique blend of content creation and technical SEO expertise to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your content strategy.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
